description: Version of proposed internal schema; this document is design only.
Unique namespaced source record ID; never reuse provider IDs across providers.
Namespaced match ID; cross-provider equivalence requires verified match mapping.
Period 1/2/3/4; null if unknown; preserve period even when timestamps reset.
Seconds since period start; null when alignment is unverified; never silently use clip time.
Unmodified provider timestamp to make conversion auditable.
Provider convention or UNKNOWN; distinguishes match clock; period clock; source frames.
Original source frame or image index; null for event-only data.
Namespaced clip ID; null for complete-match event source.
Elapsed clip seconds where video exists; not substituted for match timestamp.
Verified alignment offset within period; null until anchored.
Verified namespaced identity; unknown team remains null.
Clip-scoped class such as left/right; separate from persistent team_id.
Verified provider/roster identity; null for anonymous predictions.
Only from confirmed roster mapping; null is valid for first MVP.
Dataset/provider/source release, e.g. statsbomb_open or soccernet_gsr.
Document method: provider_event; event_freeze_frame; reference_annotation; optical_tracking; broadcast_detection; extrapolated; manual_annotation.
Original event/image/tracking row identifier; preserve joins.
Official source or rights-holder inventory URL.
Release/commit/API schema version; UNKNOWN until verified.
Source-file checksum once acquired; null in unavailable data.
Versioned agreement/license reference; UNKNOWN must block study use.
Name native units/origin/axis orientation/direction; not an implied universal pitch.
metre; normalized_0_1; normalized_0_100; provider_120_80; UNKNOWN. Numeric ranges are coordinates, not scores.
Actual or explicitly documented model length; null if unknown; no hidden 105 m assumption.
Actual or documented model width; null if unknown.
positive_x; negative_x; UNKNOWN, scoped to team and period.
Versioned coordinate conversion/calibration reference; preserve native coordinates separately.
LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/UNKNOWN from documented review rules; never a fabricated numeric confidence score.
LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/UNKNOWN; independent of identity confidence.
LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/UNKNOWN; cannot assign HIGH just because track_id is stable.
Measured held-out landmark error for relevant frame/window; null if unmeasured or not applicable; never zero by default.
pixels or metres; must accompany numeric calibration_error.
Algorithm/manual procedure and version; null for provider event coordinates with no supplied calibration.
Measured usable visible duration divided by eligible target duration in coverage_window; range 0..1; null for unknown. Not confidence.
Exact period/time boundaries and inclusion rule defining visible_fraction denominator.
Reasons such as occlusion; offscreen; cut; replay; identity_ambiguous; calibration_failed; extrapolated; source_error_unknown.
Explain unknown or not-applicable quality values and reference measurement protocol.
YES/NO/UNKNOWN; rights or required identity/coordinate uncertainty blocks inclusion.
Source frame for tracking; null allowed for StatsBomb event snapshots that lack video frame.
Verified source fps; null for event-triggered snapshots; never densify snapshots into trajectories.
Clip/segment-scoped trajectory ID; null if snapshot has no persistent identity.
Contiguous camera segment; tracks reset on cuts; null for native provider event snapshot.
Ground position in declared coordinate system; null if not measured; no zero filling.
Ground position in same system; x/y must be both finite or both null.
Whether object was within observable view; null if source does not report it.
True for actual detections; false for extrapolated records; null when unknown. Distinct from visibility.
Observable ground region used for neighbourhood completeness; null if unavailable.
player; goalkeeper; referee; ball; other; UNKNOWN; ball identity is not player identity.
Namespaced event ID; enables source-verified freeze-frame/event joins.
Raw or explicitly mapped taxonomy; record definitions version; no inferred events from proximity alone.
Provider definition/version or reviewed annotation protocol; UNKNOWN prevents exact compatibility.
Event origin in coordinate_system; null if absent.
Event origin y; coordinate pair completeness required.
Pass/carry endpoint when present; null when absent/not applicable.
Endpoint y; no fabricated zeros.
Provider outcome required for completed-pass eligibility when such features are evaluated.
Verified recipient; null if unobserved.
Unmodified source qualifiers such as shot_assist/xG; never substitute incompatible provider values.
Provider_event/manual_reviewed/estimated/UNKNOWN; label estimates distinctly.
